Dansks klares, perfekt verarbeitetes Design ist seit 1954 das ideale für Funktionalität und Stil. Unsere skandinavischen Designwurzeln aus der Mitte des Jahrhunderts beeinflussen unsere Zukunft. Unsere lässigen, kreativen Produkte für das Zuhause sind kunstvoll gefertigt, um die Räume, Momente und Erlebnisse des jeden Tages zu ergänzen. Bei Dansk ehren wir Kreativität über Konformität und feiern diese mutigen, bunten Momente bei jeder Mahlzeit. Dieser moderne Speiseteller aus weißer Keramik verfügt über drei schlanke Linien von Königsblau entlang seiner inneren und äußeren Ränder, die dem Stück einen Hauch von Farbe und Kontrast verleihen, wodurch er ideal für lässige Mahlzeiten in der Woche mit der Familie ist. Entworfen von Niels Refsgaard 1977.

كان تصميم دانسك النظيف والمصمم بشكل مثالي مثاليًا لكل من الكفاءة والأناقة منذ عام 1954. تؤثر جذور تصميمنا الاسكندنافي في منتصف القرن دائمًا على مستقبلنا. منتجاتنا الكاجوال والإبداعية المصنوعة للمنزل مصنوعة بشكل فني لتكمل المساحات واللحظات والتجارب كل يوم. في دانسك، نحن نكرم الإبداع بشأن التوافق ونحتفل بتلك اللحظات الجريئة والملونة في كل وجبة. يتميز طبق العشاء الحديث هذا المصنوع من السيراميك الأبيض بثلاثة خطوط رفيعة من اللون الأزرق الملكي على طول حدوده الداخلية والخارجية مما يضيف لمسة من اللون والتباين إلى القطعة، مما يجعله مثاليًا للوجبات الأسبوعية غير الرسمية مع العائلة. تصميم Niels Refsgaard عام 1977.

O design limpo e perfeitamente trabalhado da Dansk é ideal tanto para funcionalidade quanto para estilo desde 1954. Nossas raízes de design escandinavo do meio do século influenciam consistentemente o nosso futuro. Nossos produtos casuais e criativos feitos para a casa são criados para complementar os espaços, momentos e experiências do dia a dia. Na Dansk, honramos a criatividade sobre a conformidade e celebramos aqueles momentos ousados e coloridos em cada refeição. Feito de cerâmica branca, este prato de jantar moderno apresenta três linhas finas de azul real ao longo de suas bordas internas e externas que adicionam um toque de cor e contraste à peça, tornando-o ideal para refeições casuais de fim de semana com a família. Projetado por Niels Refsgaard em 1977.

自 1954 年以來,Dansk 的乾淨、完美工藝的設計一直是功能性和時尚的理想選擇。 我們的中世紀斯堪的納維亞設計根源不斷影響我們的未來。 我們為家庭打造的休閒創意產品,精心製作,以補充日常生活的空間、時刻和體驗。 ​ 在 Dansk,我們尊重創造力,並慶祝每餐中大膽、多彩的時刻。 這款現代餐盤採用白色陶瓷製成,內部和外部邊境沿著 3 條皇家藍細線,增添色彩與對比,使其成為和家人一起休閒的夜驚魂的理想選擇。 Niels Refsgaard 於 1977 年設計。

自 1954 年以来,Dansk's 干净、完美的设计一直是功能和风格的理想选择。 我们中世纪的斯堪的纳维亚的设计根源不断地影响我们的未来。 我们的家居休闲创意产品精心打造,以补充日常空间、时刻和体验。 在Dansk,我们尊重合一创造力,并庆祝每餐中那些大胆、多彩的时刻。 这款现代餐盘采用白色陶瓷制成,饰有三条细长皇家蓝,沿其内外边框增添了一抹色彩和对比,非常适合与家人一起休闲周游晚餐。 由 Niels Refsgaard 于 1977 年设计。

Dansk의 깨끗하고 완벽하게 제작된 디자인은 1954년부터 기능과 스타일 모두에 이상적입니다. 우리의 중세 스칸디나비아 디자인 뿌리는 우리의 미래에 지속적으로 영향을 미칩니다. 가정용으로 제작된 캐주얼하고 창의적인 제품은 일상적인 공간, 순간, 경험을 보완하기 위해 예술적으로 제작되었습니다. Dansk는 순응에 대한 창의성을 존중하고 모든 식사에서 대담하고 다채로운 순간을 축하합니다. 화이트 세라믹으로 제작된 이 현대적인 디너 플레이트는 내부 및 외부 테두리를 따라 세 개의 슬림 라인이 특징이며, 색상과 대비를 더하여 가족과 함께 캐주얼한 평일 저녁 식사에 이상적입니다. Niels Refsgaard가 1977년에 디자인했습니다.

About Polish Pottery
Polish pottery is known for its versatility in the kitchen and on the table. It is safe for use with food in the microwave, freezer, oven and dishwasher. Polish stoneware is resilient to abrasives making it durable and resistant to scratching or chipping. It distributes heat evenly for perfect baking and is also nonstick for easy clean-up, making it easy to care for.
The bright patterns never fade, and are offered in thousands of variations to mix and match. It is this combination of function and beauty that makes Polish pottery so appealing. The pottery is fired in electric and gas kilns at temperatures exceeding 2200 degrees Fahrenheit.
This results in a stoneware that is meant to resist aging and provide lasting beauty that stands the test of time. Polish stoneware is lead and cadmium free.
Polish Pottery is hand crafted and hand painted in the Boleslawiec region of Poland. This region is famous for its naturally found white clay which artisans have used for centuries to craft this durable and beautiful stoneware. Each piece of pottery is carefully formed and painted by hand to ensure that exceptional attention to detail is paid to each piece. About Polish Pottery
Polish pottery is known for its versatility in the kitchen and on the table. It is safe for use with food in the microwave, freezer, oven and dishwasher. Polish stoneware is resilient to abrasives making it durable and resistant to scratching or chipping. It distributes heat evenly for perfect baking and is also nonstick for easy clean-up, making it easy to care for.
The bright patterns never fade, and are offered in thousands of variations to mix and match. It is this combination of function and beauty that makes Polish pottery so appealing. The pottery is fired in electric and gas kilns at temperatures exceeding 2200 degrees Fahrenheit.
This results in a stoneware that is meant to resist aging and provide lasting beauty that stands the test of time. Polish stoneware is lead and cadmium free.
Polish Pottery is hand crafted and hand painted in the Boleslawiec region of Poland. This region is famous for its naturally found white clay which artisans have used for centuries to craft this durable and beautiful stoneware. Each piece of pottery is carefully formed and painted by hand to ensure that exceptional attention to detail is paid to each piece. The most beautiful and intricate patterns are called UNIKAT patterns. These patterns bear the artist’s signature.

description:
From the Manufacturer

For many years GlassOfVenice has focused solely on direct import and worldwide distribution of authentic Murano Glass from Venice, Italy. GlassOfVenice was founded by a team of people with passion for Italy and Venice and appreciation of Venetian artistic heritage. The company carries the full range of Murano Glass crafted by the top artisans, from jewelry to tabletop, vases, sculptures, and chandeliers. GlassOfVenice stocks all its products in the U.S. warehouse and ships to retail and wholesale customers worldwide.

Product Description

This gorgeous accent plate/ashtray is a fine example of the long-standing Murano glass-making tradition with its complexity, artistry and beauty. Rich blue and red stripes are not painted but created in an elaborate process entirely by hand by fusing thin canes of Murano Glass using Filigrana method developed on Murano Island in the 16th century. For centuries Venice's artists and artisans successfully merged the traditions and techniques of the Western Europe and the Orient to craft pieces that were outstanding in colors, designs, and lasting appeal. Today the tradition continues, and this accent plate is a wonderful example of the continuity of Venetian art through the centuries. The bright colors combined with subtle sparkles and unique design create a piece that brings to mind the luminous colors and lights of Venice. The look of the plate is further enhanced by its artistic shape with gentle curves and flowing contours giving it modern spin on classic elegance. This beautiful Murano Glass piece makes a great gift for anyone with appreciation of Venetian tradition, European decorative art, and Italian style.

Measurements: The accent plate measures 4 inches on each side and has a symmetrical shape. It comes with a certificate of authenticity.
This accessory can be used as an ashtray or as a decorative piece to brighten up your interior design.

Because each Murano

About Polish Pottery
Polish pottery is known for its versatility in the kitchen and on the table. It is safe for use with food in the microwave, freezer, oven and dishwasher. Polish stoneware is resilient to abrasives making it durable and resistant to scratching or chipping. It distributes heat evenly for perfect baking and is also nonstick for easy clean-up, making it easy to care for.
The bright patterns never fade, and are offered in thousands of variations to mix and match. It is this combination of function and beauty that makes Polish pottery so appealing. The pottery is fired in electric and gas kilns at temperatures exceeding 2200 degrees Fahrenheit.
This results in a stoneware that is meant to resist aging and provide lasting beauty that stands the test of time. Polish stoneware is lead and cadmium free.
Polish Pottery is hand crafted and hand painted in the Boleslawiec region of Poland. This region is famous for its naturally found white clay which artisans have used for centuries to craft this durable and beautiful stoneware. Each piece of pottery is carefully formed and painted by hand to ensure that exceptional attention to detail is paid to each piece. The most beautiful and intricate patterns are called UNIKAT patterns. These patterns bear the artist’s signature.

IHR began in an old village school in Germany in 1977, when Ingrid and Hanjo rick conceived the idea of producing accessories in the arts and crafts tradition in order to communicate their concept of interior design. More than 8,000 items are offered today in most countries of the world.

Collier Campbell의 믿음은 모든 사람들이 좋은 디자인을 사용할 수 있어야 하며 날카로운 독창성과 사전 예방적인 디자인에 대한 풍부한 명성을 쌓아온 접근 방식을 뒷받침합니다. 패턴 냅킨과 어울리는 플레이트와 코디네이팅 솔리드를 페어링하여 다이나믹한 테이블 망토와 멋진 장소 설정을 만드세요. 접시와 냅킨은 다양한 크기로 제공되므로 믹스 앤 매치하고, 레이어링 및 커스터마이징이 가능합니다. 이상적인 가정 범위는 양심적인 소비자에게 지속 가능한 옵션을 제공하며, 가장 안전한 티슈, 잉크 및 인쇄 공정을 사용하여 100% 생분해성 냅킨을 생산합니다. IHR 잉크는 물에 용해되며 중금속이나 용제를 함유하지 않으며 독일 식품 및 건강 법률 및 USFDA의 요구 사항을 충족합니다. 사용된 잉크는 하수로 버려지지 않으며 항상 재활용되어 색상 시스템에 다시 통합됩니다. 생산 작업 영역은 자연적으로 오염이 없고 유해한 배출물이 생성되지 않습니다. IHR은 1977년 독일의 오래된 마을 학교에서 시작했습니다. 잉그리드와 한조 릭은 인테리어 디자인에 대한 개념을 전달하기 위해 예술과 공예 전통에서 액세서리를 생산하는 아이디어를 고안했습니다. 오늘날 전 세계 대부분의 국가에서 8,000개 이상의 제품이 제공됩니다.

About Polish Pottery
Polish pottery is known for its versatility in the kitchen and on the table. It is safe for use with food in the microwave, freezer, oven and dishwasher. Polish stoneware is resilient to abrasives making it durable and resistant to scratching or chipping. It distributes heat evenly for perfect baking and is also nonstick for easy clean-up, making it easy to care for.
The bright patterns never fade, and are offered in thousands of variations to mix and match. It is this combination of function and beauty that makes Polish pottery so appealing. The pottery is fired in electric and gas kilns at temperatures exceeding 2200 degrees Fahrenheit.
This results in a stoneware that is meant to resist aging and provide lasting beauty that stands the test of time. Polish stoneware is lead and cadmium free.
Polish Pottery is hand crafted and hand painted in the Boleslawiec region of Poland. This region is famous for its naturally found white clay which artisans have used for centuries to craft this durable and beautiful stoneware. Each piece of pottery is carefully formed and painted by hand to ensure that exceptional attention to detail is paid to each piece. The most beautiful and intricate patterns are called UNIKAT patterns. These patterns bear the artist’s signature.

About Polish Pottery
Polish pottery is known for its versatility in the kitchen and on the table. It is safe for use with food in the microwave, freezer, oven and dishwasher. Polish stoneware is resilient to abrasives making it durable and resistant to scratching or chipping. It distributes heat evenly for perfect baking and is also nonstick for easy clean-up, making it easy to care for.
The bright patterns never fade, and are offered in thousands of variations to mix and match. It is this combination of function and beauty that makes Polish pottery so appealing. The pottery is fired in electric and gas kilns at temperatures exceeding 2200 degrees Fahrenheit.
This results in a stoneware that is meant to resist aging and provide lasting beauty that stands the test of time. Polish stoneware is lead and cadmium free.
Polish Pottery is hand crafted and hand painted in the Boleslawiec region of Poland. This region is famous for its naturally found white clay which artisans have used for centuries to craft this durable and beautiful stoneware. Each piece of pottery is carefully formed and painted by hand to ensure that exceptional attention to detail is paid to each piece. The most beautiful and intricate patterns are called UNIKAT patterns. These patterns bear the artist’s signature.

About Polish Pottery
Polish pottery is known for its versatility in the kitchen and on the table. It is safe for use with food in the microwave, freezer, oven and dishwasher. Polish stoneware is resilient to abrasives making it durable and resistant to scratching or chipping. It distributes heat evenly for perfect baking and is also nonstick for easy clean-up, making it easy to care for.
The bright patterns never fade, and are offered in thousands of variations to mix and match. It is this combination of function and beauty that makes Polish pottery so appealing. The pottery is fired in electric and gas kilns at temperatures exceeding 2200 degrees Fahrenheit.
This results in a stoneware that is meant to resist aging and provide lasting beauty that stands the test of time. Polish stoneware is lead and cadmium free.
Polish Pottery is hand crafted and hand painted in the Boleslawiec region of Poland. This region is famous for its naturally found white clay which artisans have used for centuries to craft this durable and beautiful stoneware. Each piece of pottery is carefully formed and painted by hand to ensure that exceptional attention to detail is paid to each piece. The most beautiful and intricate patterns are called UNIKAT patterns. These patterns bear the artist’s signature.

About Polish Pottery
Polish pottery is known for its versatility in the kitchen and on the table. It is safe for use with food in the microwave, freezer, oven and dishwasher. Polish stoneware is resilient to abrasives making it durable and resistant to scratching or chipping. It distributes heat evenly for perfect baking and is also nonstick for easy clean-up, making it easy to care for.
The bright patterns never fade, and are offered in thousands of variations to mix and match. It is this combination of function and beauty that makes Polish pottery so appealing. The pottery is fired in electric and gas kilns at temperatures exceeding 2200 degrees Fahrenheit.
This results in a stoneware that is meant to resist aging and provide lasting beauty that stands the test of time. Polish stoneware is lead and cadmium free.
Polish Pottery is hand crafted and hand painted in the Boleslawiec region of Poland. This region is famous for its naturally found white clay which artisans have used for centuries to craft this durable and beautiful stoneware. Each piece of pottery is carefully formed and painted by hand to ensure that exceptional attention to detail is paid to each piece. The most beautiful and intricate patterns are called UNIKAT patterns. These patterns bear the artist’s signature.

About Polish Pottery
Polish pottery is known for its versatility in the kitchen and on the table. It is safe for use with food in the microwave, freezer, oven and dishwasher. Polish stoneware is resilient to abrasives making it durable and resistant to scratching or chipping. It distributes heat evenly for perfect baking and is also nonstick for easy clean-up, making it easy to care for.
The bright patterns never fade, and are offered in thousands of variations to mix and match. It is this combination of function and beauty that makes Polish pottery so appealing. The pottery is fired in electric and gas kilns at temperatures exceeding 2200 degrees Fahrenheit.
This results in a stoneware that is meant to resist aging and provide lasting beauty that stands the test of time. Polish stoneware is lead and cadmium free.
Polish Pottery is hand crafted and hand painted in the Boleslawiec region of Poland. This region is famous for its naturally found white clay which artisans have used for centuries to craft this durable and beautiful stoneware. Each piece of pottery is carefully formed and painted by hand to ensure that exceptional attention to detail is paid to each piece. The most beautiful and intricate patterns are called UNIKAT patterns. These patterns bear the artist’s signature.

Her paintings feature tables of abundant flowers, ripe fruits and elaborate Chinese pots and jugs in singing colors. The attainable excellence that Giclee printmaking affords makes the reproduction virtually indistinguishable from the original piece. The result is wide acceptance of Giclee by galleries, museums, and private collectors. Gallery wrap is a method of stretching an artist's canvas so that the canvas wraps around the sides and is secured a hidden, wooden frame. This method of stretching and preparing a canvas allows for a frameless presentation of the finished painting.

description:
For more than 200 years Churchill Blue Willow has graced the finest tables in the World. It is the worlds most popular pattern in the history of Dinnerware. There is a legend behind this design "Once upon a time there lived a very wealthy mandarin who had a beautiful daughter named Hong Shee, who fell in love with her fathers sectretary, a man named Chang. To keep them apart, the mandarin imprisoned his daughter in the palace. One day she escaped, and the two lovers raced over the bridge to the waiting boat, with the mandarin in pursuit, they managed to elude the mandarin, reach the boat, and sail away. A storm developed, the boat foundered and the couple were lost at sea. It is said that the two love birds appeared immediately after-the spirits of Hong Shee and Chang." To represent elements of the legend, traditional Willow has several prominent features a tea house with a pavilion on the right. An Orange tree stands behind. A willow tree dominates the centre. In front of the willow is a bridge with three people. A boat with a person in it appears top left with another building and tree. And of course the two love birds face each other at the top.You today can enjoy the history by using Willow in a formal or casual setting. This vintage feel is applied to the Four 10" Dinner plates in the set for 4. Manufactured in fine English Earthenware, Blue Willow Dinnerware products are both Microwave & Dishwasher safe. This collection is endorsed by Churchill China with its 200 years of history in the manufacture of dinnerware for the home.

Durante más de 200 años Churchill Blue Willow ha adornado las mejores mesas del mundo. Es el patrón más popular del mundo en la historia de la vajilla. Hay una leyenda detrás de este diseño "Érase una vez allí vivió un mandarín muy rico que tenía una hermosa hija llamada Hong Shee, que se enamoró de su secretario de padres, un hombre llamado Chang. Para mantenerlos separados, el mandarín encarceló a su hija en el palacio. Un día escapó, y los dos amantes corrieron por el puente hasta el barco de espera, con el mandarín en persecución, lograron eludir el mandarín, llegar al barco y navegar lejos. Se desarrolló una tormenta, el barco fundó y la pareja se perdió en el mar. Se dice que los dos pájaros de amor aparecieron inmediatamente después de los espíritus de Hong Shee y Chang." Para representar elementos de la leyenda, el sauce tradicional tiene varias características prominentes una casa de té con un pabellón a la derecha. Un naranjo se encuentra detrás. Un sauce domina el centro. Frente al sauce hay un puente con tres personas. Un barco con una persona en ella aparece arriba a la izquierda con otro edificio y árbol. Y, por supuesto, los dos pájaros del amor se enfrentan entre sí en la parte superior.Hoy puede disfrutar de la historia usando Willow en un entorno formal o casual. Esta sensación vintage se aplica a los cuatro platos de cena de 10.0 in en el set para 4. Fabricado en fina loza inglesa, los productos de vajilla de sauce azul son aptos para microondas y lavavajillas. Esta colección está avalada por Churchill China con sus 200 años de historia en la fabricación de vajilla para el hogar.

Seit mehr als 200 Jahren ziert Churchill Blue Willow die besten Tische der Welt. Es ist das weltweit beliebteste Muster in der Geschichte von Geschirr. Es gibt eine Legende hinter diesem Design "Einmal lebte es eine sehr wohlhabende Mandarine, die eine schöne Tochter mit dem Namen Hong Shee hatte, die sich in ihren Sektretär des Vaters verliebt hat, einen Mann namens Chang. Um sie auseinander zu halten, hat die Mandarine seine Tochter im Palast gefangen. Eines Tages ist sie entkommen und die beiden Liebhaber rasten über die Brücke zum wartenden Boot, mit der Mandarine auf der Suche nach der Jagd gelangten sie die Mandarine, das Boot zu erreichen und wegzussegeln. Ein Sturm entwickelte, gründete das Boot und das Paar wurde auf See verloren. Es wird gesagt, dass die beiden Liebesvögel unmittelbar nach den Geistern von Hong Shee und Chang erschienen." Um Elemente der Legende zu repräsentieren, hat traditionelle Weide mehrere prominente mit einem Teehaus mit einem Pavillon auf der rechten Seite. Ein Orangenbaum steht hinter sich. Ein Weidenbaum dominiert die Mitte. Vor der Weide befindet sich eine Brücke mit drei Personen. Ein Boot mit einer Person erscheint oben links mit einem anderen Gebäude und Baum. Und natürlich stehen die beiden Liebesvögel oben gegenüber. Heute können Sie die Geschichte genießen, indem Sie Weide in einer formellen oder lässigen Umgebung verwenden. Dieses Vintage-Gefühl wird auf den vier 25,4 cm großen Speisetellern im Set für 4 Personen aufgetragen. Hergestellt aus feinem englischen Steingut, Blue Willow Geschirr-Produkte sind sowohl mikrowellen- als auch spülmaschinenfest. Diese Kollektion wird von Churchill China mit seiner 200-jährigen Geschichte in der Herstellung von Geschirr für das Zuhause unterstützt.

Há mais de 200 anos, a Churchill Blue Willow tem enfeitado as melhores mesas do mundo. É o padrão mais popular do mundo na história dos utensílios de jantar. Há uma lenda por trás deste design "Era uma vez viveu uma tangerina muito rica que tinha uma linda filha chamada Hong Shee, que se apaixonou pelo secretário de seus pais, um homem chamado Chang. Para mantê-los separados, o tangerina aprisionou sua filha no palácio. Um dia, ela escapou, e os dois amantes correram sobre a ponte para o barco espera, com a mandarim em perseguição, eles conseguiram fugir da mandarim, alcançar o barco e velejar para longe. Uma tempestade se desenvolveu, o barco fundou e o casal se perderam no mar. Dizem que os dois pássaros do amor apareceram imediatamente após o espírito de Hong Shee e Chang." Para representar elementos da lenda, a tradicional Willow tem várias características proeminentes em uma casa de chá com um pavilhão à direita. Uma laranjeira fica atrás. Um salgueiro domina o centro. Na frente do salgueiro há uma ponte com três pessoas. Um barco com uma pessoa nele aparece no topo esquerdo com outro edifício e árvore. E, claro, os dois pássaros se enfrentam na parte superior. Você hoje pode desfrutar da história usando Willow em um ambiente formal ou casual. About Polish Pottery
Polish pottery is known for its versatility in the kitchen and on the table. It is safe for use with food in the microwave, freezer, oven and dishwasher. Polish stoneware is resilient to abrasives making it durable and resistant to scratching or chipping. It distributes heat evenly for perfect baking and is also nonstick for easy clean-up, making it easy to care for.
The bright patterns never fade, and are offered in thousands of variations to mix and match. It is this combination of function and beauty that makes Polish pottery so appealing. The pottery is fired in electric and gas kilns at temperatures exceeding 2200 degrees Fahrenheit.
This results in a stoneware that is meant to resist aging and provide lasting beauty that stands the test of time. Polish stoneware is lead and cadmium free.
Polish Pottery is hand crafted and hand painted in the Boleslawiec region of Poland. This region is famous for its naturally found white clay which artisans have used for centuries to craft this durable and beautiful stoneware. Each piece of pottery is carefully formed and painted by hand to ensure that exceptional attention to detail is paid to each piece. The most beautiful and intricate patterns are called UNIKAT patterns. These patterns bear the artist’s signature.

description: Ceramic decorative plate to hang on the wall (interior or exterior) made with the dry rope techinque, a piece of the best quality and handcrafted, made with enamels cooked in a ceramic oven. This magnificent product is handcrafted in Seville in Spain. An ideal complement to decorate the home. Once the pieces are molded, they are baked at 1070ºC in a special oven. After the first firing, the product is decorated for the first time with all colors except gold, then it is recoated for the second time at 945ºC and then, in the case of products decorated with gold, it is enriched with dissolved liquid gold, with particules resins, which during the third and last firing of 720ºC are burned and leaving only 24 carat gold on the surface. The origin of "Cuerda Seca" (Dry Rope) techinque goes back to medieval times when the great cities of southern Spain, Sevilla, Córdoba, where the main centers of Western art and culture. In this environment expert master ceramists combined two noble materials; gold and enamel, to create extraordinary works of art today appreciated worldwide. The designs of these pieces have a clear geometric muslim influence. Attention: Handpainted pieces. Colours, sizes and shapes may suffer slight differences. Clean with a dry cloth.

About Polish Pottery
Polish pottery is known for its versatility in the kitchen and on the table. It is safe for use with food in the microwave, freezer, oven and dishwasher. Polish stoneware is resilient to abrasives making it durable and resistant to scratching or chipping. It distributes heat evenly for perfect baking and is also nonstick for easy clean-up, making it easy to care for.
The bright patterns never fade, and are offered in thousands of variations to mix and match. It is this combination of function and beauty that makes Polish pottery so appealing. The pottery is fired in electric and gas kilns at temperatures exceeding 2200 degrees Fahrenheit.
This results in a stoneware that is meant to resist aging and provide lasting beauty that stands the test of time. Polish stoneware is lead and cadmium free.
Polish Pottery is hand crafted and hand painted in the Boleslawiec region of Poland. This region is famous for its naturally found white clay which artisans have used for centuries to craft this durable and beautiful stoneware. Each piece of pottery is carefully formed and painted by hand to ensure that exceptional attention to detail is paid to each piece. The most beautiful and intricate patterns are called UNIKAT patterns. These patterns bear the artist’s signature.

About Polish Pottery
Polish pottery is known for its versatility in the kitchen and on the table. It is safe for use with food in the microwave, freezer, oven and dishwasher. Polish stoneware is resilient to abrasives making it durable and resistant to scratching or chipping. It distributes heat evenly for perfect baking and is also nonstick for easy clean-up, making it easy to care for.
The bright patterns never fade, and are offered in thousands of variations to mix and match. It is this combination of function and beauty that makes Polish pottery so appealing. The pottery is fired in electric and gas kilns at temperatures exceeding 2200 degrees Fahrenheit.
This results in a stoneware that is meant to resist aging and provide lasting beauty that stands the test of time. Polish stoneware is lead and cadmium free.
Polish Pottery is hand crafted and hand painted in the Boleslawiec region of Poland. This region is famous for its naturally found white clay which artisans have used for centuries to craft this durable and beautiful stoneware. Each piece of pottery is carefully formed and painted by hand to ensure that exceptional attention to detail is paid to each piece. The most beautiful and intricate patterns are called UNIKAT patterns. These patterns bear the artist’s signature.

About Polish Pottery
Polish pottery is known for its versatility in the kitchen and on the table. It is safe for use with food in the microwave, freezer, oven and dishwasher. Polish stoneware is resilient to abrasives making it durable and resistant to scratching or chipping. It distributes heat evenly for perfect baking and is also nonstick for easy clean-up, making it easy to care for.
The bright patterns never fade, and are offered in thousands of variations to mix and match. It is this combination of function and beauty that makes Polish pottery so appealing. The pottery is fired in electric and gas kilns at temperatures exceeding 2200 degrees Fahrenheit.
This results in a stoneware that is meant to resist aging and provide lasting beauty that stands the test of time. Polish stoneware is lead and cadmium free.
Polish Pottery is hand crafted and hand painted in the Boleslawiec region of Poland. This region is famous for its naturally found white clay which artisans have used for centuries to craft this durable and beautiful stoneware. Each piece of pottery is carefully formed and painted by hand to ensure that exceptional attention to detail is paid to each piece. "תיהנו משולחן חד פעמי ללא אשמה שבאמת אמא ידידותית לטבע המחפשת צלחות חד פעמיות ניתנות לקיפול לאירוע הקרוב? אז לכו על אלה שנועדו להיות כפי שניתן! אוסף השקיות שלנו עשוי מסיבי סוכר טבעיים וחומרי גבעול חיטה שנזרקים באופן טבעי שאחרת היו מתבזבלים. כך שלא כמו צלחות נייר המערבות כריתת עצים, הצלחות שלנו מתייחסות אליכם במוצר קומפוסטציאלי שהוא 100% ללא עץ. רוצים ללכת בדרך בר קיימא? לכו על שקית השקית. הגשת קינוחים יציבים בקלות; הגישו סטייקים או מרקים כבדים בביטחון מלא. מיוצר בתהליך של חום גבוה ולחץ גבוה, הלוחיות המתכלות הללו עמידות במיוחד ונוזלים. אז לא עוד עוגות נופלות על הרצפה או מרקים דולפים דרכו. צלחות השקייה שלנו מבטיחות שהאורחים שלכם יוכלו ללעוס בקלות דרך הארוחה הזו, ותהנו זמן קל לאחר מכן הודות לנוחיות החד פעמית. בין אם זו חתונה או מסיבת יום הולדת, גיוס כספים או טיול קמפינג, צלחות אלה שומרות על דברים ידידותיים לסביבה וללא בלגן. הנה כמה סיבות נוספות לאהוב את הצלחות החד פעמיות האלה: - ניתן להשתמש כדי להגיש מאכלים חמים, קרים, שמנוניים או רטובים. - הצלחות בטוחות לשימוש במיקרוגל לנוחות נוספת. - הסט כולל 500 (6) ו-500 (9) צלחות כדי לתת לך ערך נהדר. - ניתן לקומפוסט מלא במתקני קומפוסט תעשייתיים. - צורה מרובעת אלגנטית ומרקם טבעי משאירים רושם מעולה. - ללא פלסטיק, אקונומיקה, צבעים, חומרי הדברה או שעווה. - מגובה על ידי 100% שביעות רצון הלקוח. לחצו על הוסף לעגלה כדי ליהנות מיכולת חד פעמית ללא סיכון לחלוטין! "
